Product recommendation third-party notices

The bundled q8 ONNX model is Xenova/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2,
revision 2c4055b12046f11709e9df2c122e59ffbdc2f900. Xenova converted the
Sentence Transformers model to ONNX. The upstream model declares Apache-2.0.
The original conversion model card is included alongside the model assets.

https://huggingface.co/Xenova/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2/tree/2c4055b12046f11709e9df2c122e59ffbdc2f900
https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2

The Apache 2.0 text is supplied by the Transformers.js 3.8.1 npm package.
The ONNX Runtime Web 1.22.0-dev.20250409-89f8206ba4 WASM binary is bundled
by Vite from the lockfile-pinned ONNX Runtime Web dependency, which uses
the MIT license.
The ONNX Runtime license and third-party notices were obtained from
Microsoft's ONNX Runtime 1.22.0 distribution on PyPI.

https://pypi.org/project/onnxruntime/1.22.0/
